# designs-room (format: runtime/input.h), played from a town save by tools/scenes.py (the save
# is not in this repository). As house.txt up to 3500: in the player's room.
# Save: rod. DOWN, Y opens the pockets, the pen on the designs tab (3904, ov121/my_designs.c,
# in the player's own room): a design dragged onto the carpet button and laid turned (4144); one
# onto the wallpaper button, its choice moved by the keys and left, then again and laid as it
# is; two designs swapped, one put down as a design display (twice), one onto the last button;
# B twice closes the page.
